title: .claude/settings.json: allow a cloud seat to create and push its own mailbox branch (`claude/mailbox-*`), so an auto-mode seat can sit without a manual mode switch
body:
security#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcW9L8Noz9BxEwjwiov

Filing gate ③ (maintainer direct dispatch) · Source: maintainer — verbatim in the security#2 session on 2026-11-28: 「在仓库的 .claude/settings.json 里加一条允许规则再提交。立卡」, then 「立卡并派发」.

## Problem

A cloud seat opens its mailbox with `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --head claude/mailbox-<slug>`. The relay has no ref-creating op, so the seat must first create one empty commit on `origin/main` and push it to `claude/mailbox-<slug>` itself. `mailbox-open.mjs` says this when it refuses.

In an auto-mode cloud session, no allow rule covers that commit or that push. On 2026-11-28 the auto-mode classifier denied the push from the security#2 seat three times (`[Destructive or Unwanted Actions]`). One of those denials came after the maintainer had approved it in chat. The seat could only sit after the maintainer switched the session out of Auto mode.

`.claude/settings.json` already allows the card-branch forms (#35443): `Bash(git commit -F *)` and `Bash(git push -u origin claude/issue-*)`. Mailbox branches have no equivalent.

## What to change

`.claude/settings.json`, following the shape #35443 used:

- **`permissions.allow`** gains two rules:
  - `Bash(git commit --allow-empty -F *)`
  - `Bash(git push -u origin claude/mailbox-*)`
- **`permissions.ask`** gains three guards, so that only the bare forms run without approval:
  - `Bash(git commit --allow-empty -F * *)`
  - `Bash(git push -u origin claude/mailbox-* *)`
  - `Bash(git push -u origin claude/mailbox-*:*)`
- **`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`:** where it refuses a cloud seat, its message names exactly these three commands, one per line, so a seat copies them straight into the allowed forms. Keep the existing `--head` instruction.
  - `git switch -c claude/mailbox-<slug> origin/main`
  - `git commit --allow-empty -F FILE`
  - `git push -u origin claude/mailbox-<slug>`

Unchanged:

- the `deny` roster;
- `main`'s ruleset;
- the hooks, including `check:commit-card-trailers`, which still judges the mailbox commit's trailer pair.

## Acceptance

- `node scripts/pm/check-settings-deny-roster.mjs` passes, and the file parses as JSON.
- The PR body lists what runs without approval and what still asks, as #35443 did.
- `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` (or its existing tests) passes with the reworded refusal pinned.

## Business reason

Who benefits: every cloud PM seat. Each seat opens one mailbox per tenure, and at present, in Auto mode, that step needs the account owner present to switch modes. Without this change a seat summoned in Auto mode stalls half-seated, or the owner has to babysit the step.

## Reader

- **Dispatched by:** security#2, by the maintainer's direct order above, to one os-dev as `mode:subagent`.
- **Size:** S. **Tier:** H (governed `.claude/**` surface).
- **Merge:** the maintainer merges it himself, as with #35443.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed cards for `settings.json allow`: 66 hits, none on mailbox branches. The nearest are #35443 (card branches, merged), #23860 and #23432 (other allow rows, closed). Searched for `mailbox branch push denied`: no open card on this.
